This is the story of Ruthie and her family during one of the World Wars. Her father has to go away to war, and times are hard. It's her family's year to provide a Christmas tree for the village church's Christmas service. Ruthie is also set to be the angel in the annual Christmas pageant. Will Ruthie and her mom be able to get the tree in time for the pageant?
